implementation: Readable portable C99 integer and packed-decimal value algorithms; no ROM execution, CPU emulator or host floating point

implemented_routines.name: 32-bit two's-complement negation
implemented_routines.scope: All uint32_t bit patterns with defined unsigned arithmetic

implemented_routines.name: biased decimal magnitude extraction
implemented_routines.scope: Canonical decimal/marked/rational/surd/error scalars; raw sign classification, rational bias conversion, surd/error F3 payload extraction and ten-digit extraction after adding 10^10

implemented_routines.name: BCD magnitude to word
implemented_routines.scope: Ten decimal digits modulo2^32; original BIN carry and pre-negation failure behavior

implemented_routines.name: signed word to BCD magnitude
implemented_routines.scope: All32-bit words; BIN signed16 admission and unchanged destination on range rejection

implemented_routines.name: BCD magnitude record serialization
implemented_routines.scope: Canonical signed32 records and exact returning BIN rejection partial records; zero residual pair native recurrence returns explicit UNIMPLEMENTED

implemented_routines.name: NOT
implemented_routines.scope: Canonical scalar metadata and all returning ordinary inputs; incoming BIN carry ignored, exact native partial serialization preserved, zero residual pair non-return boundary explicit

implemented_routines.name: NEG
implemented_routines.scope: Canonical scalar metadata word extraction; signed32 minimum and BIN positive overflow reject with native R0=3 and original record retained

implemented_routines.name: OR
implemented_routines.scope: Canonical scalar metadata conversion and full 32-bit logical result; incoming BIN carry ignored, returning partial serialization exact, proven zero-pair non-return explicit

implemented_routines.name: XOR
implemented_routines.scope: Canonical scalar metadata conversion and full 32-bit logical result; incoming BIN carry ignored, returning partial serialization exact, proven zero-pair non-return explicit

implemented_routines.name: XNOR
implemented_routines.scope: Canonical scalar metadata conversion and full 32-bit logical result; incoming BIN carry ignored, returning partial serialization exact, proven zero-pair non-return explicit

implemented_routines.name: AND
implemented_routines.scope: Canonical scalar metadata conversion and full 32-bit logical result; incoming BIN carry ignored, returning partial serialization exact, proven zero-pair non-return explicit

implemented_routines.name: range admission
implemented_routines.scope: R0=0,R6=2 ordinary mathematical bounds and explicit canonical raw headers0/2/4/6/8/F sign/tag dispatch; strict CD60 header rejection retained

implemented_routines.name: stored scalar BASE-N preparation
implemented_routines.scope: Post-bank-fetch scalar decimal/rational/surd conversion, metadata removal, F3 stored-error and empty-payload 6x/9x reference rejection, truncation then range check; bank copying and secondary clearing are caller-owned

implemented_routines.name: truncate toward zero
implemented_routines.scope: Ordinary decimal value preparation and successful scalar division conversion/truncation, including marked/rational/surd quotients; no native scratch claim

implemented_routines.name: ADD wrapper
implemented_routines.scope: Prepared mode2 canonical decimal/marked/rational/surd/error scalars; exact arithmetic then raw E82 check, computed record retained on range error, every F* input normalized toF3

implemented_routines.name: SUBTRACT wrapper
implemented_routines.scope: Prepared mode2 canonical decimal/marked/rational/surd/error scalars; exact arithmetic then raw E82 check, computed record retained on range error, every F* input normalized toF3

implemented_routines.name: MULTIPLY wrapper
implemented_routines.scope: Prepared mode2 canonical decimal/marked/rational/surd/error scalars; exact arithmetic then raw E82 check, computed record retained on range error, every F* input normalized toF3

implemented_routines.name: DIVIDE wrapper
implemented_routines.scope: Prepared mode2 canonical decimal/marked/rational/surd/error scalars; exact quotient then scalar conversion/truncation without range validation, every F* input normalized toF3

implemented_routines.name: radix literal parser
implemented_routines.scope: Digit-token scan, all256 token termination/error classifications, leading-zero capacity, BIN16/OCT11/DEC10/HEX8 significant-digit budgets, signed input interpretation, selected-radix range rejection, exact status/cursor/first-record partial writes

gaps: Shared expression grammar/precedence, variable bank copy and controller integration are separate parser/controller work
Malformed BCD/compact records and input/output-token storage overlap are outside the documented APIs
BIN logical serialization with a zero residual pair has an exact CPU/RAM recurrence in the original; value API returns explicit UNIMPLEMENTED without changing output/status
Full RAM scratch/register writes and mode/keyboard controllers are separate subsystems
